title: Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Who We Are

Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products!

As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as of January 2027, as Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. 

What Will Your Role Be

As a Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) in our Merchant Experience team, you’ll help build and evolve the digital products our partners and merchants interact with every day. You’ll work across the entire merchant journey — from the Partner Area, where designers manage their designs and shops, to the sign-up and publishing experience that turns an idea into a live SpreadShop, and the Merchant Area, where SpreadConnect merchants manage integrations with Shopify, TikTok, and other platforms. As a Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d), you’ll take ownership beyond individual UI components or API endpoints. You’ll design and implement features end-to-end, collaborate closely with product and design, and ensure that the experiences you build are reliable, performant, and easy to evolve. Your work directly impacts how merchants use and grow with our platform. You’ll build products that make their day-to-day work easier and help drive our business forward.

What You´ll Do 

  • Build and evolve merchant-facing product surfaces — sign-up and shop creation flows, shop management, design and product administration, sales statistics

  • Build the new publishing journey for shops — from sign-up to a live SpreadShop — and take drop-off out of every step

  • Own small to medium features end to end: design the UI, build theKotlin/Spring endpoints behind it, model the data, and ship both together

  • Extend our backend services where your features need it — new REST endpointsin the shop and partner services, data model changes with a proper migration, and integrations with external platforms such as Shopify or TikTok on the SpreadConnect side

  • Design and consume our REST and GraphQL APIs, and push back when a responseshape makes the frontend's life harder than it needs to be

  • Contribute to our cross-team frontend architecture work — shared components,hooks and API clients, and how we render, test and ship our apps

  • Keep merchant tooling fast — data-heavy tables, sales statistics and editorsare where perceived performance is won or lost

  • Take on larger topics — an epic, a new integration, a new merchant surface —and break them down into something the team can execute: slices, dependencies, open questions, and a first piece worth shipping

  • Work in an agile cross-functional team with a product owner, designers and backend engineers, and connect what you build to merchant activation and conversion

What You´ll Bring

  • Solid proficiency in TypeScript and React — component design, hooks, statemanagement, and the performance patterns that keep a growing app fast

  • Around three or more years of professional experience building web products, with a track record of features you carried from first ticket to production

  • Real CSS craft and experience working inside a design system or shared component library, not just against one

  • Experience consuming REST or GraphQL APIs and working with structured, data-heavy responses — product catalogs, variants and attributes bring more complexity than they first appear to

  • Working experience in a JVM backend — Kotlin or Java with Spring — and the ability to build a REST endpoint, model the data behind it and write the migration, not just read the code

  • A solid grasp of relational databases and SQL, and of what happens to a query when the table stops being small

  • Self-direction: you take an under-specified problem, find out what is actually needed, break it into deliverable pieces and drive them to donewithout waiting to be handed tickets

  • Testing as a habit rather than an afterthought, and a working relationship with code review

  • A keen eye for UI detail — you care about how something feels, not only whether it works

  • A product mindset: you ask who benefits from a change before you ask how to build it

  • Good communication skills in English

Why Should You Join Us

 

  • Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business.

  • Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so.

  • We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another.

  • Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company.

  • Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change.

  • The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We value diversity at Spread Group. We are proud of and continue to encourage the increasing diversity of our company culture and community. Your skills, talents, and experience are our focus no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital or disability status.

Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result.

You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing.


  • Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably.

  • Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design.

  • Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later.

  • Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs.

  • Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate.

How we work:

  • AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production.

  • Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence.

  • Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital.

  • Data protection: EU-only inference and no patient data in logs are hard constraints.

  • Ownership: product owns what we build and why. The tech lead owns how it’s built and that it ships.

  • Stack: TypeScript, Node.js and Go, Python for inference, Postgres, React, AWS Bedrock, Docker and Datadog.

  • Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built with LLMs yourself and understand where they fail: non-determinism, cost, latency and evaluation. You can design systems around them and challenge our AI engineers’ choices. Experience running an LLM or agent system in production is a strong plus, and strong personal projects count.

  • Evals: you can answer “how did you know it was good enough?” with ground truth, regression tests and a clear taxonomy of error classes.

  • Full-stack depth: you go deep across backend, frontend and data, and you commit code.

  • Other people’s systems: you’re comfortable with asynchronous pipelines, legacy interfaces and code written by others. Hospital experience isn’t required.

title: CMO Partner Manager - Contract Manufacturing (all genders)
description:
Your role

As our CMO Partner Manager (all genders), you will serve as the strategic interface between our internal teams (R&D, Quality, Operations) and external manufacturing partners. You will own your product categories end-to-end - securing product availability, driving cost efficiency, and leveraging external manufacturing intelligence to spark innovation within our supply chain.

  • Drive Security of Supply: Guarantee product availability and eliminate stockouts through proactive risk management, robust capacity planning, and flawless data tracking (ETAs).

  • Manage & Scale Partner Networks: Continuously screen the market for new manufacturing capabilities, onboard strategic CMO partners, and manage day-to-day partner operations.

  • Optimize TCO & Commercials: Build deep market insight into raw material and manufacturing costs to negotiate optimal pricing, terms, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).

  • Drive Launch Execution: Direct New Product Introductions (NPI) from concept to market launch, ensuring cross-functional and partner alignment to meet project timelines.

  • Champion Quality & Efficiency: Hold partners accountable to strict delivery reliability (OTIF) and swift quality resolution (CAPA), while bringing external best practices back to internal operations.

Your profile

  • Background & Experience: 5+ years in strategic procurement, category management, or contract manufacturing (CMO) - ideally in dietary supplements, FMCG, food, or pharma. Experience in complex batch manufacturing is a strong plus.

  • Strategic & Commercial Acumen: You understand how procurement drives value beyond unit price - leveraging TCO models, raw material cost structures, and smart negotiations to optimize margins.

  • Project & Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives (e.g., NPIs). You excel at bridging internal teams (R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, Accounting, Legal) with external manufacturing partners to keep projects moving.

  • Data & Analytical Mindset: Highly data-driven and comfortable with large datasets. You translate operational metrics and spend data into clear priorities, actionable insights, and negotiation leverage.

  • Process & System Orientation: You think in scalable systems—capable of refining workflows (P2P, SOPs, partner onboarding) and maintaining data integrity without overengineering processes.

  • Tech Stack: Hands-on experience with modern ERP systems (e.g., Odoo or similar MRP), project platforms (e.g., monday.com), and BI tools (e.g., Tableau or Salesforce).

  • Language Skills: Fluent in English (C1); German or Polish proficiency is a strong advantage.

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Apply with your CV and cover letter.

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

title: Portfolio Commercial Director
description:
WOULD YOU LIKE TO BE PART OF A FAST - GROWING ORGANISATION? 

JOIN US AS AREA COMMERCIAL DIRECTOR!

ABOUT ODYSSEY 

We're The Odyssey Hotel Group, Europe’s most ambitious hotel operator and the team behind many famous global hospitality names. We partner with Marriott, IHG, and Accor to develop exceptional properties across various brands, from Holiday Express to Marriott's Autograph collection. Powered by over 800 employees and supported by Activum SG as our major shareholder, our purpose is to shape hospitality together!

ABOUT POSITION

The Portfolio Commercial Director is responsible for the overall commercial performance of a blended portfolio of full service hotels, strongly MICE driven hotels in key markets in Germany.

This role holds end-to-end accountability for commercial strategy and execution, covering Sales, Revenue Management, Distribution, and Marketing, with a strong focus on sustainable revenue growth, market share expansion, and profitability, while ensuring alignment with owner expectations and long-term asset value creation.

As a senior commercial leader, the role acts as a trusted advisor to hotel owners and asset managers, delivering transparent, data-driven insights and ensuring that all commercial strategies support both short-term performance and long-term financial returns.

The position operates within a matrix organisation, partnering closely with Operations, Finance, and commercial discipline leaders to drive integrated commercial strategies across the portfolio.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop and execute hotel-level commercial strategies aligned with overall business goals.

• Lead forecasting and budgeting processes to ensure accurate financial planning and performance tracking.

• Drive commercial initiatives at both the hotel and country levels to maximize total hotel revenue opportunities.

• Executive report on results and present business analytics to internal and external stakeholders.

• Act as primary commercial liaison with Hotel Operations, ensuring alignment between commercial and operational priorities.

• Oversee account management and achieving sales targets, maintaining strong customer and partner relationships.

• Manage pricing and inventory strategy, ensuring optimal yield and market competitiveness.

• Develop, manage, and recruit commercial team members, in close cooperation with the relevant commercial disciplinary leader, to build strong regional capabilities and performance.

• Lead structured owner communication, including monthly and quarterly reviews, clearly articulating performance drivers, risks, and opportunities

HOW YOU WILL DO IT

• Building strong and trusted relationships with hotel owners, asset managers, Hotel Managers, and internal stakeholders.

• Applying sound commercial judgement and data-driven decision-making to drive revenue growth, market share, and profitability.

• Translating complex commercial performance data into clear business insights and actionable strategies.

• Aligning Sales, Revenue Management, Marketing, and Operations around common business objectives.

• Proactively identifying risks, opportunities, and market trends and adapting commercial strategies accordingly.

• Providing clear direction, coaching, and support to commercial teams, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.

• Influencing stakeholders at all levels through effective communication, collaboration, and executive presence.

• Maintaining a strong focus on owner satisfaction, long-term asset value creation, and sustainable business growth.

• Ensuring commercial excellence through structured planning, forecasting, performance reviews, and continuous improvement.

• Balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to deliver measurable business results.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 5-8+ years of experience in hotel commercial leadership, across Sales, Revenue Management, or Commercial Operations

  • Proven experience in multi-property / regional roles

  • Strong track record in driving revenue growth, market share, and profitability

  • Deep expertise in:

    • Revenue Management (pricing, forecasting, distribution)

    • Commercial strategy and demand generation

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with hotel owners, asset managers, or investors

  • Strong analytical capability with ability to translate data into strategic insights

  • Experience presenting budgets, forecasts, and performance to senior stakeholders

  • Proven leadership in building and managing high-performing teams

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills

  • Ability to operate effectively in a matrix organisation

  • Results-driven mindset with focus on asset value and long-term performance

  • Full professional fluency in English and German (written and spoken)

What do we offer

  • A competitive salary with bonus plan

  • Holiday & Christmas bonus after 6 months

  • laptop, phone and appropriate travel compensation depending of what fits your needs

  • A diverse, multicultural, and dynamic work environment

  • Respective of your work scope, discounted stays at large branded hotels worldwide such as Marriott, IHG and all Odyssey properties

  • 30 vacation days from day one for a healthy work-life balance

  • Access to a health card to reimburse health related invoices - Health insurance card with €300 annual budget

  • Access to “Corporate Benefits” discounts

  • Ongoing training, personal growth opportunities, and priority access to internal vacancies.

  • €500 net referral bonus for new hires

description:

Wir entwickeln Software, IT-Services und digitale Lösungen für Kassenärztliche Vereinigungen und Krankenversicherungen. Unsere Produkte helfen dabei, ambulante medizinische Versorgung zu steuern, zu digitalisieren und effizienter zu gestalten – für Millionen Patienten in Deutschland.

Mit über 25 Jahren Erfahrung im deutschen Gesundheitswesen und rund 300 Experten an deutschen Standorten verbinden wir tiefes Markt-Know-how mit moderner Technologie. Unsere Kunden setzen auf uns, weil wir die komplexen regulatorischen und operativen Anforderungen des Gesundheitsmarktes kennen und passgenaue Lösungen dafür liefern.

  • Greenfield: Du baust unseren AI-Coding-Stack von Grund auf – kein Legacy-Setup, keine Altlasten

  • Mobile Office

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • JobRad: Fahrrad-Leasing zur beruflichen und privaten Nutzung
  • Attraktive MitarbeiterInnen-Rabatte
  • Offene Feedback-Kultur und individuelle Weiterbildung
  • Interdisziplinäre Aufgaben
  • Agile & digitale Unternehmensstrukturen
  • Über 20 Jahre Wissen & Erfahrung in der digitalen Gesundheitswelt

Dafür brauchen wir Dich

  • AI-Coding-Stack: Du baust unseren internen Stack für agentische Softwareentwicklung von Grund auf – Auswahl, Konfiguration und Betrieb der Coding-Agent-Umgebung, bewusst modell- und anbieterneutral.
  • Testautomatisierung & Dokumentation: Du schließt unsere größten technischen Lücken: automatisierte Integrations- und End-to-End-Tests sowie agententaugliche technische Dokumentation im Repository.
  • Quality Gates: Du etablierst automatisierte Code-Reviews als festen Bestandteil unserer CI/CD-Pipeline und baust eine synthetische Test-Daten-Factory auf, die den gesamten Workflow aus dem DSGVO-Scope hält.
  • Aktive Entwicklung: Du entwickelst mit – rund die Hälfte Deiner Zeit baust Du reale Features über genau die Pipeline, die Du aufsetzt. Der Mix ist wellenförmig: Phasen intensiver Stack-Arbeit wechseln mit Phasen aktiver Entwicklung.
  • Governance: Du definierst die verbindlichen KI-Vorgaben für unsere externen Entwicklungsdienstleister und verantwortest das interne Quality Gate. Dabei führst Du kein Team – gefragt ist fachliche Autorität, keine disziplinarische.
  • Wissenstransfer: Du arbeitest einen internen Kollegen ein, der die Rolle gemeinsam mit Dir trägt und den Stack langfristig mitverantwortet.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Du hast rund 7-10 Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung auf Senior- oder Lead-Niveau hinter Dir, mit Architekturverantwortung. Java und Spring Boot im Backend, idealerweise Angular im Frontend.
  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (C1) und fließend Englisch und hast einen Wohnsitz in Deutschland.
  • Microservices, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL und CI/CD sind für Dich Alltag. Testautomatisierung hast Du nicht nur genutzt, sondern aufgebaut.
  • Du arbeitest täglich mit agentischen Coding-Werkzeugen wie Claude Code, Cursor oder Codex und orchestrierst mehrere Agenten parallel. Jahreszahlen erwarten wir hier ausdrücklich nicht – diese Arbeitsweise gibt es erst seit Ende 2025.
  • Du pflegst eigene Kontext-Dateien, Skills und System-Prompts und kannst sie uns zeigen. Du hast eine belastbare Antwort darauf, wie Du agentengenerierten Code verifizierst.
  • Du kannst begründen, warum Du welches Werkzeug einsetzt – statt dem jeweils neuesten Trend zu folgen.
  • Du verstehst Business, nicht nur Technik, und kannst gegenüber externen Dienstleistern Standards setzen und durchsetzen.
  • Wünschenswerte Kenntnisse: Idealerweise hast Du bereits eine eigene agentische Entwicklungs-Pipeline aufgebaut – inklusive Review und Testing, beruflich oder privat. Erfahrung in regulierten Umfeldern sowie in der Steuerung externer Entwicklungsdienstleister ist von Vorteil.

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
If you've been looking to join a fast-growing startup with a bold vision, exciting challenges and the opportunity to make a genuine difference in the world, you've found the right place.

Backed by General Catalyst, the investors behind companies like Stripe and Airbnb, we're building something extraordinary.


Our Mission 🌎

At Goodstack, our mission is to revolutionize how the world does good. We envision a world where doing good is built into everything we do.

As a fast-growing, AI-native social impact startup, we're building the technology and infrastructure that connects businesses and good causes, making it easier to give, grow and create meaningful impact at scale.

We do this in two ways:

  • Goodstack for Business helps some of the world's leading companies power their social impact programmes.

  • Goodstack for Causes helps nonprofits access the funding, technology and resources they need to thrive.

And we're already making a difference:

  • $11 billion in donations facilitated since 2022.

  • Over 13 million mission-driven organisations in the world's largest verified database.

  • 500,000+ nonprofits on our platform, with thousands more joining every week.

  • Trusted by global companies including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Open AI, Canva, TikTok and Airbnb, alongside nonprofits such as the Red Cross, Cancer Research UK and Oxfam.


What We're Building Next 🚀

We're entering an exciting new chapter: evolving beyond software into an AI-native business that delivers meaningful outcomes for businesses and nonprofits worldwide.

By combining AI, automation and human expertise, we're building a future where companies can manage global giving programmes more seamlessly, and nonprofits can access funding faster and more efficiently.

Our ambition is bold, and the challenges are complex. We're looking for curious, ambitious and AI-native thinkers who take ownership, challenge assumptions and use technology creatively to solve meaningful problems.

That's where you come in 🫵

Join us as People Operations Specialist and help us build a People function that’s simple, dependable, and able to scale!

💜 We are considering applications for both permanent and contract employment 💜


We're looking for someone to join us in building the next chapter of our People function at Goodstack.

Over the past four years, we've grown more than 8x, from 22 to around 200 Goodstackers across multiple countries. It's been an incredible journey, and with that kind of growth comes a whole lot of interesting challenges.

We've built a strong foundation, but there's plenty of opportunity to make the experience of working at Goodstack even better.

We're looking for someone who enjoys People Operations, gets satisfaction from making complicated things simple, and cares just as much about the little details as the bigger picture. Someone who understands good HR practices, takes ownership, asks thoughtful questions and doesn't wait to be told what needs doing.

In this role, you'll have plenty of autonomy, the opportunity to shape how we work, and a close partnership with the Head of People as we continue scaling the function.


✍️ A note from the Head of People:

Hey, future Goodstacker! 👋

I don't expect you to know everything (who does?), but I do expect you to know your HR foundations, bring good judgement, take ownership and stay curious.

And if you're the kind of person who gets a little too excited about a beautifully organised process, I have a feeling we'll get along brilliantly!


As People Operations Specialist, your mission will be:

Making the Goodstacker experience brilliant

  • Own the end-to-end employee lifecycle, from onboarding and employment changes to offboarding, ensuring every experience is smooth, organised and thoughtful.

  • Prepare and quality-check employment contracts, amendments and other documentation, ensuring accuracy and alignment with applicable employment requirements.

  • Keep our People systems, employee records and documentation accurate, organised and up to date.

  • Be the go-to person for day-to-day People questions, providing sound HR guidance, resolving routine matters independently and escalating more complex issues.

  • Partner with Talent, Finance, IT, managers and external providers to ensure smooth coordination across teams.

Keeping global People operations running smoothly

  • Coordinate payroll inputs, deadlines, employee benefits and employment changes across our locations.

  • Manage the operational administration of our international Employer of Record (EOR) arrangements.

  • Support right-to-work checks, immigration and sponsorship administration.

  • Apply HR policies and employment best practices consistently, identifying compliance risks and escalating them early.

  • Keep on top of statutory deadlines and employment obligations, working with external specialists when needed.

Making things better as we grow

  • Coordinate the operational delivery of performance reviews, progression and compensation cycles.

  • Maintain People reporting, policies, templates and internal documentation.

  • Use your HR knowledge to identify gaps in our processes and recommend practical improvements.

  • Find opportunities to simplify workflows and use AI and automation to eliminate repetitive work.


What success looks like:

  • Every new Goodstacker has what they need before Day 1 and feels welcomed from the start.

  • Contracts, payroll inputs, employee changes and records are accurate and delivered on time.

  • Our people and managers can count on you for reliable advice, clear answers and helpful support.

  • You apply sound HR judgement, spot risks early and resolve routine matters without constant oversight.

  • Our People processes run smoothly, with fewer manual steps and less time spent chasing admin.

  • You proactively identify opportunities to strengthen compliance, consistency and the employee experience.

  • Ultimately, you're creating the operational reliability that allows us to spend more time improving the experience of working at Goodstack.


This role is a perfect match for you if you have:

  • 3+ years of hands-on People / HR Ops experience, ideally in a growing, international business.

  • A formal qualification in Human Resources Management, People-related degree, CIPD, or an equivalent recognised professional qualification.

  • A solid understanding of UK employment legislation and HR best practices, with the confidence to apply your knowledge to everyday People matters.

  • Experience preparing employment documentation, managing employee lifecycle processes and supporting payroll and benefits administration.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when handling contracts, payroll, employee data and anything where accuracy really matters.

  • Strong organisational skills and follow-through, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.

  • Experience with UK HR administration, alongside exposure to international employment or EOR arrangements.

  • Confidence working with People systems, spreadsheets and payroll processes, with a strong understanding of confidentiality and data handling.

  • Sound judgement and ownership, knowing how to solve problems independently and when to ask for support.

  • Clear, kind communication and a genuine interest in helping people.

  • An AI-native mindset, using AI, automation and technology thoughtfully to simplify work, improve accuracy and increase efficiency.


Bonus if you have:

  • Worked in a fast-growing startup and enjoy building things as you go.

  • Experience automating People Ops workflows.

  • A soft spot for a good cup of tea or smoothie 🫖.

🇬🇧 What you can expect upon joining our team

💰 Salary reviews and share options becoming an integral part of our growth and share in the company's success

title: Senior Software Engineer (AppSec)
description:
About us

Trigger.dev is the platform for running reliable AI agents and workflows. Developers use it to build, deploy, and scale production systems with built-in tools for orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, and debugging.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users’ code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. Today, we serve thousands of teams building AI apps and agents, handling hundreds of millions of executions per month.

About the role

You’ll own security at Trigger.dev: our infrastructure, our app, the runtime that runs our users’ code, and the secrets they trust us with.

Some of our customers let their own users run code on Trigger.dev (think coding agents running whatever instructions they’re given). That code must never reach our systems or our customers’ systems. Keeping it contained is a feature we ship, so this is a product engineering role as much as a security one.

About half to three quarters of your time will be backend engineering. The rest is hunting for problems and fixing them. When you find something, you own the fix. You’ll set your own priorities and work with others when necessary.

We’re looking for an application security (AppSec) engineer who builds: a senior backend engineer who brings a security mindset to everything they ship.

What you’ll do

  • Sandbox and runtime security. Design and harden the environments that isolate untrusted user code. This is the core of the role.

  • Security features for customers. Build things like end-to-end encrypted secrets, log redaction, private networking, and runtime hardening.

  • Automated offensive testing. Use AI tools to attack our own systems on a schedule, find weak spots, and fix them. Bring in outside pen testers when it’s worth it.

  • Detection and response. Build monitoring and alerting for suspicious activity, improve our security observability, and lead the response when something needs a look.

  • Vulnerability management. Run scanning and triage, own our vulnerability disclosure program, and handle incoming reports.

  • Automated quality. Own our security PR reviews, automated scans, fixes, and triage.

  • Write it down. Document how we do security so the rest of the team can answer customer questions with confidence.

  • Security habits. Help the engineering team build secure habits with reviews, docs, and light guardrails.

Like everyone at Trigger.dev, you’ll also help in our Discord and GitHub community, write docs, and create content like blog posts, code examples, and videos.

What we’re looking for

  • Senior backend engineer. You design and ship production backend systems yourself.

  • AppSec experience. You’ve done hands-on application security work, such as secure code review, threat modelling, pen testing, CTFs or bug bounties. You don’t need a security job title or to have run a security team.

  • Cloud operations. You’ve run production systems in the cloud.

  • Multi-tenant systems. You’ve built or secured systems where many customers share the same infrastructure.

  • TypeScript. You’re comfortable working in it. Our codebase also uses Go and Rust.

  • AI-forward. You use AI tools to automate testing, detection, and defense.

  • Startup pace. You’ve worked somewhere a step or two ahead of where we are, so you know what good looks like at our size.

  • Owner’s mindset. You take work off the team’s plate and fix what you find.

  • On call. Reliability and security response are shared across the team.

  • In-person time. You’re open to team events a few times a year.

You’ll stand out if you have

  • Built or hardened sandboxes: containers, microVMs, gVisor, Firecracker, WASM, or similar.

  • Secured platforms where customers have their own customers.

  • A track record in bug bounties or CTFs.

  • Contributed to open source.

  • Worked at a developer tools, infrastructure, or open source company.

  • Experience with Go or Rust.

Benefits

  • Compensation and equity. Generous, transparent pay, plus equity so everyone shares in the company’s success.

  • Async working. Need a heads-down day or a meeting-free day? No problem.

  • Home office. We help with equipment so you’re as productive at home as in the office.

  • Vacation. 25 days plus national holidays, sick leave, and generous parental leave.

  • Training budget. An annual budget for books, courses, or an Audible subscription.

  • Pension. Join our company scheme, or we’ll pay into your private pension.

Our values

  • We’re proud to be open source. We believe in the open source community and in building a great free-to-use product.

  • We ship uncomfortably fast. Moving fast is key for a startup. We’re pragmatic about what we build and when.

  • We work autonomously. We decide as a team what will help our customers most, and prioritize from there.

title: Systems Simulation & Performance Modelling - Member of Technical Staff
description:
About Us

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.

Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor.

In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence.

We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Callosum believes that scaling heterogeneous AI infrastructure requires understanding how emerging hardware will behave as part of larger computational systems. Performance characteristics measured on individual accelerators rarely translate directly to distributed deployments, where networking, memory, and execution strategies introduce new constraints. We are developing simulation infrastructure that allows us to explore these interactions and evaluate future systems before they exist.

This role advances the simulation and performance modelling tools that inform Callosum's hardware and infrastructure decisions. You will extend models that project device-level performance to rack-scale systems, explore alternative hardware configurations and execution strategies, and provide experimental environments for automated optimisation. The work also encompasses profiling, workload tracing, and performance instrumentation, connecting measurements from real systems to accurate and useful models of those we want to build.

What You'll Build

  • Extend our simulators to predict heterogeneous compute performance from individual accelerators to multi-rack deployments.

  • Model networking, memory, and execution behaviour to evaluate alternative system architectures and configurations.

  • Develop profiling, tracing, and workload capture tools that inform and validate simulation models.

  • Extend simulation environments for rapid experimentation and automated optimisation of systems and algorithms.

  • Characterise emerging accelerator architectures and translate hardware measurements into predictive models of system-level performance.

What Sets You Apart

  • Strong experience in systems simulation, performance modelling, or performance-critical systems software.

  • Deep understanding of computer architecture, distributed systems, or high-performance computing.

  • Familiarity with profiling, tracing, instrumentation, and methods for characterising computational workloads.

  • Strong systems programming experience, ideally including C++ or Rust.

  • Ability to reason about modelling accuracy, abstraction, and trade-offs between simulation fidelity and computational cost.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience

  • Equity & Ownership

  • Private healthcare

  • We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us

We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, and believe in equal opportunities for all.

  • Build evaluation methods that measure model quality and establish the trade-offs introduced by hardware-aware adaptations.

  • Experience in model architecture research, efficient inference, or hardware-aware machine learning.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is the default infrastructure layer for real-time AI, the platform that gives AI the ability to see, hear, and speak. From powering voice for millions of ChatGPT users to enabling drone teleoperation at Skydio and serving as the backbone for roughly 25% of 911 emergency calls in the U.S., LiveKit handles the real-time media layer that production AI applications depend on.

Over 300,000 developers and 5,000+ companies from leading AI labs to Fortune 500 enterprises run production workloads on LiveKit. We've raised $181M from investors including Index Ventures, Altimeter Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and we're growing fast. Now we're building the sales team to match.

About This Role

We're hiring an Enterprise SDR to drive top-of-funnel pipeline for our enterprise sales motion. You'll be the first impression LiveKit makes on engineering leaders, product organizations, and AI/ML teams at companies building the next generation of voice and multimodal AI applications.

This is not a boilerplate SDR role. Our buyers are technical staff engineers, heads of infrastructure, VP-level AI product leaders and they can smell a templated sequence from a mile away. You'll need to understand what LiveKit actually does, why developers reach for it over rolling their own WebRTC stack, and how to translate that into compelling, relevant outreach for each account you work.

You'll partner closely with our enterprise AEs and work directly with sales and marketing leadership tto sharpen messaging and positioning as we scale our GTM functions.

What You'll Do

  • Own outbound pipeline generation targeting Fortune 2000 accounts across key verticals: including healthcare, financial services, and technology companies.

  • Work closely with the broader GTM org marketing, solutions engineering, and product on campaign strategy, ICP refinement, and feedback loops that sharpen our enterprise motion

Who You Are

  • 3–5 years of SDR or BDR experience, ideally at a developer tools, infrastructure, or voice AI company

  • Genuine curiosity about technology; you don't need to write code, but you should be able to hold an intelligent conversation about why a company might choose a managed WebRTC platform over a self-hosted stack

  • Strong written communication - you know the difference between an email that gets deleted and one that gets a reply

Nice to Have

  • Background selling to engineering, DevOps, or AI/ML teams

  • Incredible developer traction. Our sales team doesn't cold-call strangers they engage with a community that already loves the product.

description:
TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Researcher to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically.

You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself.

What you will be working on

  • Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable.

  • Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data.

  • Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage.

  • Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining.

  • Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture.

  • Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you.

  • Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself.

  • Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation.

  • Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.

Nice to have

  • Computer vision and document understanding, images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD.

  • Graph and structured scientific data, molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data.

  • Synthetic worlds and simulation, a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap.

  • Foundation models from scratch, real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning.

  • Public evidence of data ownership, lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data.

  • GIS and geometry, parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization.

  • Multi-country data, heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules.

Why Join Davis

  • Own the data end to end, from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from.

  • Shape a foundation model from scratch, on a structured representation no one else is training on.

  • Work on genuinely hard problems, image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity, at a founding level, in an early-stage company.

  • Join a world-class team, a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we are a team of twelve: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability, and parametric tools only check constraints after generation, which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.

This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) AI Engineer !

 
 

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots

En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH :

  • ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids

  • c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle

Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies.

C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché, au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Notre ambition est de développer en un temps record :

  • une plateforme collaborative et ouverte, qui s'intègre nativement aux outils des cabinets et de leurs clients, respecte leurs habitudes de travail et fluidifie les échanges entre gestionnaires de paie et entreprises

  • l'automatisation de la tenue administrative : collecte des données, paramétrage des évolutions légales et des règles propres à chaque entreprise, génération automatique des rapports et formulaires, traçabilité juridique dynamique et en temps réel, etc.

  • la valorisation des données de paie et sociales, pour offrir un conseil social à 360° et enfin répondre efficacement à l'ensemble des attentes des salariés, qui se sont de surcroît largement amplifiées depuis le Covid : gestion contractuelle, pilotage de la masse salariale, avantages salariés, fidélisation des talents, mutuelle…

L'objectif : devenir le « People OS » sur lequel les cabinets et leurs clients TPE/PME s'appuient pour gérer l'intégralité de leurs problématiques paie et RH.

 

🚀 Tes responsabilités

Ta mission : faire de l'IA le levier qui démultiplie le travail de chacun chez Alassio. L'objectif est assumé : multiplier par 10 la productivité de chaque membre de l'équipe.

  • Tu formes la Growth squad avec notre Founding Strategy & Operations : ce binôme transverse optimise l'existant, automatise les workflows de toutes les équipes et fait passer nos initiatives IA et nos outils internes à l'échelle : hébergement et mise en production dans des environnements partagés, sécurité, observabilité, optimisation et amélioration continue

  • Tu deviens le (la) référent(e) IA d'Alassio : on se veut profondément AI-native et on expérimente énormément. Tu centralises et coordonnes ces initiatives pour que ce "lab interne" soit efficace, et tu expérimentes aussi en continu avec toutes les techno IA (budget et outillage conséquents)

  • Tu construis la nouvelle colonne vertébrale IT d'Alassio, en identifiant les systèmes IA qui comptent à l'échelle de toute l'entreprise

  • Tu prépares l'avenir du produit : à terme, les usages testés et éprouvés en interne sous ton impulsion ont vocation à rejoindre notre plateforme. Ils nourriront le « People OS » qui démocratise les cas d'usage les plus pertinents de l'IA dans notre secteur

 

🧭 Tes premiers chantiers

Ton point de départ : Bedrock, notre OS interne. Un peu à la manière de Palantir Foundry, il agrège & orchestre tout le contexte de l'entreprise pour en tirer des actions concrètes : suivi ultra-personnalisé et automatisé de nos utilisateurs, analyse produit, documentation, rédaction de tickets et PR associées…

Bedrock est déjà au cœur du quotidien de toutes les équipes. Mais il s'est construit par couches successives, au fil des cas d'usage ajoutés. Ton premier objectif est d'en dresser l'inventaire complet, process et outils IA compris. Tu définis ensuite la roadmap qui le fera changer de dimension :

  • Workflows : optimiser l'existant

  • Infrastructure : sécurité, confidentialité, hébergement et environnements partagés, pour un OS multi-joueur, plug-and-play et scalable

  • Observabilité : suivre les agents et leur performance, et améliorer chaque logique en continu

  • Autonomie : construire des workflows agentiques déclenchés par webhook ou planifiés, qui nettoient le contexte et mènent des missions 24/7

Très vite, tu as vocation à devenir le (la) responsable qui orchestre l'IA chez Alassio, et le (la) référent(e) de notre OS Bedrock.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

  • 1 à 2 ans d'expérience dans un rôle d'AI Engineer / FDE / AI Deployment Strategist dans une top structure tech (BCGX, Palantir, Dust)

  • Plusieurs missions concrètes de déploiement et d'optimisation de technologies IA : mise en place de zéro d'un workflow au sein d'une organisation, sujets de gouvernance et de déploiement en entreprise, etc.

  • Une utilisation intensive des outils IA et une bonne maîtrise de Python : Claude Code / Codex ; Cursor Agents, Linear/PostHog, déploiement et hébergement (cloud, AI routers, etc.)

 

💎 Qualités

  • Un goût pour l'optimisation et l'organisation : tu aimes que les choses soient claires, que l'information soit facile à mobiliser, propre et maintenable, et tu prends plaisir à produire vite des éléments actionnables

  • Un biais très fort pour l'action : tu repères les problèmes avant qu'on te les signale, et tu ne t'arrêtes jamais au diagnostic

  • Penser à l'échelle : tu conçois dès le départ des solutions capables d'encaisser des montées en charge ×10 ou ×100, tout en restant pragmatique sur ce qui compte à court et moyen terme

 
 

Processus de sélection

  1. Premier entretien avec Tancrède (CEO) : 45 min

  2. Étude de cas technique avec Hector (COO) et Ivan Robert (Founding SWE) : 1h30

  3. Rencontre informelle de l'équipe dans nos bureaux, puis échange de 45 min avec les fondateurs Ayoub (CAIO), Paul (CTO), Tancrède (CEO) & Hector (COO)

  4. Deux à trois prises de référence

 
 

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission unique

Tu rejoins une aventure entrepreneuriale en plein passage à l'échelle, sur un marché verrouillé depuis des années. On est convaincus que l'IA ne transformera pas seulement le produit et secteur qu'on construit, mais aussi la façon avec laquelle toutes les entreprises devront se réinventer. On en fait déjà l'expérience au quotidien avec Bedrock, notre OS interne qui est aujourd'hui au cœur de l'activité de toutes nos équipes tech et non-tech.

Ton rôle est de faire passer ce laboratoire à l'échelle pour que chaque équipe d'Alassio aille plus vite, avec l'ambition assumée de bâtir une référence en matière d'organisation AI-native.

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d'expertise comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Changer de logiciel de paie est un projet lourd pour un cabinet. La réussite de chaque migration est décisive : c'est elle qui fait d'un cabinet signé un cabinet convaincu, puis un ambassadeur. Pour accompagner l'arrivée de nouveaux cabinets, nous renforçons l'équipe Déploiement & Accompagnement (DnA), qui assure un suivi actif de chacun de nos cabinets partenaires.

Ce poste est le premier recrutement de l’équipe DnA. Le playbook de migration, les supports de formation et les indicateurs de suivi se construisent avec les cabinets que tu accompagnes, et c’est toi qui les feras évoluer. Concrètement, cela veut dire de l’autonomie et de l’influence réelles dès les premiers mois.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu accompagnes nos cabinets partenaires dans leur migration vers Alassio, de la formation à la mise en production, et tu incarnes la qualité de service d'Alassio auprès des équipes de gestionnaires de paie sur le terrain.

C'est un poste à la fois de pilotage et de terrain : en lien avec les équipes Sales et Product, tu mènes le projet de migration du cabinet, tu assures la formation initiale de ses gestionnaires de paie et tu animes les points de suivi tout au long de la phase pilote et des premiers mois de production.

 

🧩 Les étapes d'un déploiement

  1. Cadrage : kick-off structuré avec le cabinet, ateliers de recueil des besoins (conventions, spécificités des dossiers, reprise d'historique), planning partagé

  2. Pilote : formation initiale des gestionnaires de paie, migration d'un premier échantillon de dossiers, paies en parallèle et contrôle des écarts

  3. Déploiement : bascule progressive de dossiers supplémentaires selon le planning défini en amont, mise en production

  4. Suivi actif : accompagnement renforcé après le démarrage, puis passage de relais à l'équipe Support

 

🧭 Tes missions

  • Piloter le déploiement d'un portefeuille de 5 à 10 cabinets selon leur taille

  • Être l'interlocuteur de référence du responsable social du cabinet et de ses gestionnaires de paie ; animer les points d'étape et un bilan régulier avec chaque cabinet

  • Former les équipes : formation initiale des gestionnaires de paie, sessions de prise en main, approfondissements

  • Suivre la migration : reprise des données et des historiques, paramétrage des dossiers avec l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie, paies en parallèle et contrôle des écarts

  • Coordonner les équipes internes mobilisées sur le cabinet : Sales, paramétrage, support, produit

  • Construire et faire évoluer le playbook de migration : étapes, checklists, supports de formation, indicateurs de suivi

  • Faire remonter au Product les besoins et les irritants observés sur le terrain

 

📊 Indicateurs de réussite

  • Satisfaction des cabinets de ton portefeuille

  • Respect du planning de déploiement

  • Rapidité de résolution des demandes, en lien avec les autres équipes d'Alassio

  • Adoption d'Alassio par les gestionnaires de paie du cabinet

 

🤝 Ton environnement

  • Rattachement : Alexandre (Responsable Déploiement & Accompagnement), au sein de l'équipe DnA

  • Tu travailles en lien étroit avec l'équipe Sales et l'équipe Métier

  • À 1 mois : tu maîtrises l'outil et le playbook de migration, et tu co-pilotes un premier déploiement en binôme

  • À 3 mois : tu pilotes en autonomie tes premiers cabinets et tu contribues à l'amélioration du processus d'onboarding des cabinets

  • À 6 mois : tu gères un portefeuille complet de 5 à 10 cabinets, dont tu mènes entièrement le déploiement sur Alassio

 
 

Profil recherché

Indispensable :

  • Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en paie, en cabinet d'expertise comptable ou chez un éditeur

Un plus :

💎 Qualités

title: Backend Engineer - Platform Core
description:
Backend Engineer (Golang) – Platform Core

Location: Remote, European time zones, Full-time, Permanent

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem with waterfall enrichment: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted B2B data layer powering modern revenue teams and AI-driven workflows alike. Today, more than 5,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

About the Role:

At the heart of FullEnrich is our waterfall engine. It's the system responsible for deciding which data providers to call, in what order, under which conditions, and what happens when something fails. It works well today, but what we're building next is significantly more ambitious.

We're evolving the engine to become far more flexible and configurable, supporting account-specific requirements, dynamic routing based on different optimization goals, and seamless integration of new providers and behaviors without introducing unnecessary complexity.

This is a foundational part of our product, and getting the architecture right is critical to how we scale.

We're looking for an experienced Backend Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and taking ownership of the systems behind them.

If you've built high-throughput routing systems, designed multi-provider orchestration layers, or worked on infrastructure that needs to adapt to different customers and use cases, this is exactly the kind of challenge you'll be taking on.

What You'll Do:

  • Own and evolve our core routing engine: Take ownership of provider selection, fallback logic, load balancing, and queue management. Our waterfall currently operates as a modular Go monolith, and you'll help evolve it to support account-level customization at scale without introducing unnecessary complexity.

  • Build and improve provider integrations: Design how we connect to and manage third-party data providers, focusing on rate limiting, reliability, and observability. This includes supporting external provider credentials, configurable provider ordering, and well-defined fallback behavior when providers are unavailable.

  • Develop intelligent routing capabilities: Build the logic that dynamically selects providers based on different optimization objectives, including speed, coverage, compliance, and intelligent load balancing, while managing rate limits effectively.

  • Design scalable multi-tenant architecture: Develop the foundations for sub-accounts, customer-specific credit pools, and endpoint-level configuration, ensuring the engine remains flexible, scalable, and maintainable.

  • Build composable verification workflows: Integrate validity and compliance checks into the enrichment pipeline as configurable steps, allowing results to be independently verified regardless of their original data source.

  • Strengthen our core architecture: Improve and refactor existing systems as we scale, applying strong engineering practices to keep our codebase clean, understandable, reliable, and easy to maintain.

  • Shape technical decisions: Work closely with our engineering leadership to translate product requirements into thoughtful architectural solutions, balancing immediate needs with long-term scalability.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 3 months:

  • Develop a deep understanding of our existing waterfall engine, provider integrations, and core backend architecture.

  • Build strong relationships with the engineering team and identify opportunities to improve reliability, performance, and maintainability.

  • Start contributing to the evolution of our routing engine, taking ownership of initial architectural improvements and technical decisions.

By 6 months:

  • Take ownership of key components of our core platform, delivering meaningful improvements to provider orchestration, fallback logic, and routing capabilities.

  • Help introduce more flexible, account-level configuration while keeping the architecture clean, scalable, and maintainable.

  • Improve the reliability and observability of our provider integrations, reducing operational complexity as we scale.

By 12 months:

  • Play a leading role in delivering a more intelligent, configurable waterfall engine that supports different customer needs and optimization goals at scale.

  • Establish robust architectural foundations for multi-tenancy, composable verification, and continued provider expansion.

  • Be a trusted technical contributor within the engineering team, helping shape long-term architectural decisions and ensuring our core platform remains reliable, performant, and ready for future growth.

What We're Looking For:

  • Strong backend engineering experience: You've built and maintained production systems involving routing, fallback mechanisms, queues, concurrency, and rate limiting. You understand how distributed and multi-provider systems behave under pressure and how to design for reliability.

  • An architecture-first mindset: You're comfortable taking a product requirement, identifying potential structural challenges, and designing solutions that will stand the test of time. You think beyond implementation and consider scalability, maintainability, and long-term impact.

  • Deep experience with Golang: Go is at the core of our backend. You're confident working with modular architectures, clean code principles, and ideally hexagonal architecture.

  • Experience managing technical complexity: You can navigate systems with multiple interconnected components, from account-level configuration and provider orchestration to compliance workflows and multi-tenancy, without compromising clarity or simplicity.

  • Strong ownership and problem-solving skills: You're proactive, pragmatic, and comfortable making technical decisions. You enjoy getting into the details, understanding why systems behave the way they do, and finding solutions to challenging engineering problems.

  • A collaborative approach: You communicate clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and enjoy working with other engineers to build reliable, high-quality systems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data routing, enrichment pipelines, or multi-provider orchestration systems.

  • Experience building API marketplace infrastructure or multi-tenant SaaS backends.

  • Familiarity with API-first product architectures.

  • An interest in the evolving data infrastructure landscape.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend is built primarily in Golang, following a modular, hexagonal architecture.

Our wider stack includes:

  • Backend: Go (Golang)

  • Databases & Search: PostgreSQL, OpenSearch

  • Infrastructure: DigitalOcean, Docker

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Monitoring & Observability: Grafana

You'll be joining an engineering team of around 10 people, working on one of the most critical components of our platform.

Interview Process

We aim to keep our process straightforward, transparent, and focused on getting to know each other.

  1. Introduction to FullEnrich with our Talent team (30 min) – A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

  2. CTO & VP Engineering Interview (60 minutes): A conversation about your experience, the role, and a technical discussion based on a real experiment.

  3. Technical Assessment: A take-home exercise completed in your own time, followed by a review and discussion.

  4. Team & Culture Interview: Meet with a member of the team to learn more about how we work together and ensure there's a strong mutual fit.

FullEnrich is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or disability.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez :

Vous serez responsable de la localisation française de Device Data Management (DDM), l’un des domaines produit clés de la plateforme Kaluza. DDM consomme des flux de données internes et externes pour représenter les fournitures, compteurs, registres, relevés et consommations. Il gère aussi les parcours liés à ces entités (par exemple, la mise à jour de la configuration d’un compteur), les API qui exposent les données, les pages front-end qui les présentent aux utilisateurs, ainsi que les calculs de projection et d’extrapolation de consommation. C’est un rôle produit full-stack et très opérationnel : vous interviendrez sur tout le domaine, du modèle de données jusqu’à ce que voient les utilisateurs à l’écran.

  • Traduire les exigences du marché français en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché de l’énergie français (Enedis, GRDF, passerelle GRD, règles sur les données de compteurs et d’équipements) en exigences produit détaillées couvrant la conformité réglementaire, les flux de données des équipements et la qualité des données.

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec nos clients : collaborer main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché français pour comprendre leurs besoins et construire les exigences ensemble. Bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vous voir en premier, et vous appuyer sur cette proximité pour orienter ce que DDM construira ensuite pour la France.

  • Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel en interrogeant les données, en esquissant des contrats d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez quotidiennement des outils d’IA (ex. Claude Code) comme multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer des situations, et pas seulement pour rédiger des documents.

  • Aligner les équipes globales et locales, toutes fonctions confondues : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, la QA et bien d’autres, avec une influence full-stack, pour que tout le monde vise les bons résultats.

  • Être la personne de référence pour DDM France : faire le lien entre nos équipes globales et locales afin d’éclairer les priorités et la stratégie.

Ce que vous apportez :

Critères essentiels :

  • Une expérience avérée en tant que Product Manager, Business Analyst ou équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un solide historique de localisation réussie de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux

  • Un français courant et une grande aisance en anglais : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, vous passez donc facilement de l’un à l’autre

  • De l’aisance dans le travail direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les décideurs alignés et impliqués

  • Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard·e et opérationnel·le, vous préférez construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt qu’attendre la spécification parfaite. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les modèles de données, les bases de données et les API, et vous pouvez tenir une conversation technique. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur·e, mais vous raisonnez comme tel·le, et vous êtes aussi à l’aise pour réfléchir à un modèle de données que pour penser à ce que l’utilisateur voit à l’écran

  • Une communication claire et incisive, capable de faire le tri dans le bruit et d’expliquer la complexité technique et de marché à des interlocuteurs variés, clients compris, ainsi qu’une expérience de collaboration avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires (ingénierie, QA, BA, Programme, Delivery, etc.) pour livrer des solutions localisées

Idéalement, vous avez :

  • Une expérience dans le secteur de l’énergie en France : vous connaissez le fonctionnement du marché et ses acteurs clés (ex. Enedis / GRDF), notamment sur les données d’équipements et les flux de marché

  • Une expérience avec des plateformes de gestion de l’énergie ou de services publics (utilities) sur le marché français

  • Une bonne maîtrise des outils d’IA à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie produit, de la découverte et l’idéation jusqu’à la livraison et l’itération

  • Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

  • Résoudre le vrai problème : Dépasser la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets.

  • Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

  • Assumer les résultats : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

  • Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

 

Nos avantages

 

  • Rémunération & protection : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle Alan, prévoyance (assurance vie et décès x3) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

  • Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport domicile-travail, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €
